authentication_method.description: The Oracle Fusion Cloud authentication method.

delete_capture_frequency.description: Use this option to configure how often the connection captures deletes.

effective_date_disabled.description: Select this option to extract all historical records without applying a date filter. Console allows setting this option for all datastores in the connector.

issuer.description: The Oracle Fusion Cloud issuer name.

partial_resync_lookback_unit.description: The unit (Hours or Days) for partialResyncLookbackValue.

partial_resync_lookback_value.description: The size of the partial resync lookback window, in the unit specified by partialResyncLookbackUnit. The value must be between 24 hours and 30 days.

password.description: The Oracle Fusion Cloud user password.

perform_partial_resync.description: Once per day, re-sync data for incremental tables to catch late-arriving or backdated records that the incremental filter may miss, extending the lookback window by partialResyncLookbackValue/partialResyncLookbackUnit. Disabling this may reduce sync duration but can cause some updates to be missed.

private_key.description: The Oracle Fusion Cloud private key.

public_key.description: The Oracle Fusion Cloud public key.

server_url.description: The Oracle Fusion Cloud Instance URL.
